rule_reference: missing is a failure; deferred requires a named canonical owner and insertion contract
coverage_principle: C4-owned families + core are demonstrated with a real per-family demo note. Sibling-owned families (concepts 1/2/3) are reachable through the shared manager grammar and marked shared_grammar. The Future Server Module Shell is deferred_named_owner with named owners + insertion contracts. No family is 'missing'.

families.demo_note: Stream renders the Settings Workspace shell with a landmark river; Home is the river root landing with deferred Server region shell + Storage Health summary.

Universal search focuses via nav_focus_route; result select scrolls the river to the setting's landmark (deep link 'Open setting: {id}'). Search indexes metadata without eagerly hydrating all managers.
Full Settings Workspace with persistent left CategoryNavigation + scroll-linked SubcategoryScrollspy over the river. Loading/empty/error/unavailable/managed states shown per landmark.

Provider manager with full object model, 7 installation lifecycle fixtures (CLI found+authenticated, found-not-signed-in, multiple installations one shadowed, unknown owner manual-only, explicit install, update available, verify-failed-rollback-succeeded), CLI-owned vs PM-direct OAuth boundary, and requested/effective disclosure. Reuses catalog.provider_switch_route / account_select_profile / model_list.

SettingRow grammar across all C4 landmarks: label/value/help/scope with ValueSourceBadge (inherited/managed/default/custom), AvailabilityReason, and action/setting/status/manager variants. General fixtures (Default/Custom/Inherited/Managed/Unavailable/Validation error/Restart required/Reconnect required/Changed elsewhere) rendered.

StorageHealth landmark: server-anchored mode (one Project Home Server + physical Project Vault), retention, legal holds (managed, suspends deletion/compaction), pressure, non-destructive compaction (receipts), quarantine, project/data deletion (irreversible, receipt), encryption, periodic test-restore. DISTINCT from settings/project/full-server backup and workspace cleanup. Fixture: storage.legal_hold_active.

Backup landmark keeps action (Back Up Now) vs setting (schedule) vs status (last backup) vs manager vs log (diagnostic) DISTINCT. Back Up Now -> cmd.storage.backup_now with ObservableWork + receipt. Internal snapshots / settings backup / project backup / full server backup distinguished. Fixture: storage.backup_now.

Lifecycle landmark: export/backup, import (merge/replace + 3-conflict preview), validation, legacy-key migration, restore-point before apply, atomic apply, rollback to snapshot, receipt+source disclosure, reset-to-defaults (preview first). Copy Settings From = ONE-TIME transactional copy (~10 categories), destination independent after; NOT universal inheritance. NO raw format dropdown as primary. Fixture: lifecycle.import_3_conflicts_rollback + copy_from_project_one_time.

History landmark: project/all-project filters, compare/export/rebuild/archive/deletion policy, PM-owned vs provider-native identity, resumable sessions. Virtualized list. Reuses catalog.chat_rewind/revert/history open ids.

Runtime Artifacts landmark: type/location/version/retention/receipts/redaction/open/reveal/export/cleanup; PM-owned vs provider-native identity; identity-based open (no fake repo paths); identity-preserving export with manifest (no shadow IDs). Fixture: artifact manager rows.

Source Control landmark: changes/history/graph/worktrees, branch/bookmark/revision, Git/Jujutsu/LFS, forge connection, SSH source, test-before-merge, push/force-push policy (deny main), leases, recovery/cleanup, tool health. Reuses catalog.git_worktree_* + source_control_* + catalog.git_*. Fixture: git.force_push_deny_main.

GitHub Actions landmark: pinned workflows, current-branch readiness, refresh, run/job/log browsing, starter workflow, account capability, setup/health. Reuses catalog.github_actions_* + catalog.actions_*. Shell-surface boundary stops at hosted workflow/admin contract owned by GitHub_Integration.md.

Containers landmark: Docker/Podman/Kubernetes top-level (human) with detail (Engine/CLI/Compose/Buildx/socket/kubectl/Helm/clusters/kubeconfig-contexts/registries/Unraid/SSH-remotes/versions/auth/health). Domain capability probes reuse shared tool lifecycle. Reuses catalog.docker_*. Fixture: container.podman_stopped.

Web landmark: provider priority, search/fetch/crawl/map/extract limits, credit guards, caches, PM-native Browser sessions (NO Playwright terminology; BrowserWorkspace/Browser Program/Expert Browser Program only), proxies/certs, air-gap, privacy (no prompt exfiltration), readiness. Reuses catalog.chat_web_* + catalog.browser_*. Fixture: web.air_gap_pm_native_browser.

Search Index landmark: enable, rebuild (phase/progress non-blocking, CancellationToken on disable), exclusions, file-size/symlink policy, disk use, remote cache, clear cache, failures surfaced. Reuses catalog.search_rebuild_index + catalog.search_evict_remote_cache. Fixture: searchindex.rebuild_3_failures.

Cleanup landmark: dry-run first, worktree safety, evidence retention floor, receipts. Distinct from runtime artifact cleanup and storage compaction. Reuses catalog.docker_cleanup_scan (container-scoped) for container cleanup; new cmd.cleanup.dry_run/clean for workspace. Fixture: cleanup.dry_run_then_clean.

Deferred Server region reserves grammar + semantic destinations for Servers / Execution Hosts / Clients / Project Hosting & Files / Remote Access / Updates. Human-language cards only (Home Server Connected, Clients N paired, Hosted On, Project Files, Run Work). NO backend state machine invented here; Project Sync/Move/PM-update explicitly not implemented. Each named owner carries an insertion contract (see impact-register.deferred_named_owners).
